title: Quadpack unveils packaging collection for the new generation of haircare
summary: Driven by trends such as skinification, premiumisation and hyper-segmentation, the haircare category is moving beyond traditional shampoos and conditioners towards targeted treatments promising stronger, denser and healthier hair, as well as improved scalp health. In response to these changing expectations, Quadpack has developed a collection of packaging solutions for high-performance, targeted and personalised hair treatments. The new Haircare Collection covers a broad range of products,... - Industry buzz
